head: 8467f01
summary: 07_shell.js is unchanged since 6c64e2b, so window geometry, proportions, spacing, reveals, shades, dado, carpets and door linings are identical. The lighting final touch moved every shell surface toward the photos and broke none of them. The THE Suite bowls are now neutral and darker than the wall by the same margin as f_17313: s09 bowl 214/213/210 (B-R -4) against wall 225 (+2), and s04 bowl 210 against wall 225, vs photo bowl 211 (-1) against wall 226 (+4). That was fb-1's ask, and it keeps reveal definition through shading. The THE Room lining eased from B-R +27 to +20 in b_jClose and from +21 to +12 in the ra_jWin tub. The q12 reveal is mid-grey and neutral at L~104 (B-R +1..+9), and its edges and lip still read clearly. Being 8 L over the photo is not a shell problem. Only low items remain: the carried shell list, plus slightly more clipped door/F pane glass on the lighting side. I rate 8.6, up 0.1 because fb-1 and fb-2 are cleared with no regression.
